yard.en: One witness testified that the inmates had been so hungry that when a horse died in the yard, they had been grateful, because it meant more bones to grind, and more scraps to fight over.
yard.zh: 一位证人作证说，院民们饿得实在没办法，当院子里有一匹马死掉时，他们竟然心存感激，因为这意味着有更多的骨头可以磨，有更多的残渣可以争抢。

yard.en: There's actually an acronym for this: NIMBY, which stands for "Not In My Back Yard", and describes someone who opposes new construction in their area, worried it will change the character of the neighbourhood or reduce their own property values.
yard.zh: 其实对此有一个缩写词：NIMBY，代表“Not In My Back Yard”（不要在我家后院），用来形容那些反对在其所在地区进行新建设的人，他们担心这会改变社区的面貌或降低他们自己的房产价值。
